structured_output.what_is_happening: A 10-day-old pump.fun token (migrated to PumpSwap) named GROYPER had been dormant. It suddenly woke up: about $30k of its $37k one-hour volume came in the last 5 minutes, price is up about 300% over the hour, and there are about 99 unique buyers vs 72 sellers in the last 5 minutes. At the same moment several brand-new 'Groyper' tokens launched in the past hour, each with $35k–$117k of hourly volume, and one is even named 'BUY 46 MINUTE OLD ONE'. That points to a live Groyper / Nick Fuentes attention event outside the chain, with traders rotating into an older, migrated version. The description says 'Fees to @nickjfuentes' (a usepaid.app fee-redirect link), and the X handle is set to his account, so the token presents itself as his without any proof.

narrative.description: Groyper meme and Nick Fuentes attention. A cluster of same-name launches is happening right now, which suggests an outside trigger (a post or news involving Fuentes or Groyper). This token claims creator fees go to Fuentes's handle.
narrative.why_spreading: Many Groyper launches within the last hour with heavy volume show the theme is hot in real time. An older, migrated coin with burned LP and fees pointed at the figure himself gives traders a 'more legit' option to rotate into.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is already migrated with burned LP, it is older than the fresh spam launches, and it has the fee-to-@nickjfuentes framing. Nothing shows Fuentes endorses or even knows about it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: An older Groyper (Ajgs…pump, $175k mcap, $73k liquidity) and a GROYPER from about 5 days ago at $60k. There are also many new curve launches with $35k–$117k hourly volume. Attention is heavily split.

authenticity.evidence: Unique buyers are fairly broad (99 in 5 minutes). But GMGN flags 379 bundler wallets, a 60% bot/degen share, and bundlers holding 29% of the top trader supply. There are 56 smart and 6 renowned wallets but zero smart-money signals. No paid DEX promotion. The rest of the attention is real, but it is spread across many copycat coins.
authenticity.uncertainty: The outside trigger can't be seen from here. It is unknown whether Fuentes ever touched this token.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler presence (379 wallets, 29% of top trader supply) could dump into the pump
$16k liquidity is thin, and a 5-minute spike of +70% can reverse sharply
Competition from dozens of same-name tokens
The dev X account is linked to 176 launched tokens (serial launcher). The creator has already closed out

structured_output.counterargument: The whole move happened in one 5-minute burst after 10 dormant days, and bundlers could be exiting into it. Entry comes 4 minutes after detection, possibly near the local top. Fresh Groyper launches pull buyers away, and a 50% retrace from a 300% spike is very common. On the other side: if Fuentes or a large account notices a coin sending fees to him, the older migrated one could easily reclaim its roughly $126k ATH, which would be about 3.5x from here.
unknowns: What set off the Groyper event
Whether Fuentes can actually claim the fees or has engaged with the token
Whether the bundler wallets are the ones selling now
Whether volume keeps coming in after the first 5-minute burst

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition. Judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a revival rotation during a live Groyper attention wave. It has real breadth, burned LP and headroom up to its previous ATH, but it is heavily bundled, competes with many copycats, and was caught mid-spike. Its runner odds are somewhat above the typical coin in this pool.
